title: closure-rule
description: A syntactic generator of a closure operator: one conditional cell-update asserting that whenever a positive Pi_1 antecedent over the predication state holds, a particular cell value must be at least a given knowledge-order threshold.

antecedent.description: a positive Pi_1 condition phi(x; y; v) over the predication state that must hold for the rule to fire

positive.description: the antecedent uses only positive (monotone) atoms over the cell values

form.description: universally-quantified-prefix condition over the entity domain E

consequent.description: the cell-update v'(p)(t1, t2) >=_k V it forces

cell.description: the predicate-and-arguments cell whose value is updated

threshold.description: the value V the cell must reach at least, measured in the knowledge order >=_k

freeEntityVariables.description: the variables y; the rule fires once per y-instantiation drawn from the entity domain E

boundEntityVariables.description: the universally bound variables x ranging over E inside the antecedent
